title: Settings with defaults
description:
Load game settings, falling back to defaults for anything missing or wrong.

```
volume=0.7  fullscreen=yes  resolution=1920x1080  vsync=maybe
-> volume 0.7, fullscreen true, 1920x1080, vsync true (default: "maybe" is not yes/no)
missing file -> all defaults, file written
```
hints: Volume must be 0 to 1 (lesson 6.01's "validate every value"). For a resolution, find the `x` with `v.find('x')` and read the two sides with a `std::istringstream`, checking that both reads succeed and nothing is left over.
Keep a `std::map<std::string, std::string>` of every line read, and write it back with your changed values.
requirements: A `Settings` struct with defaults in the code.
Each value is checked; a bad one keeps the default and is reported.
Unknown keys are kept when saving, so a newer version's settings are not lost.
stretch: Add a version number and upgrade old setting names.
